• Improved Live TV channel grouping, EPG program guide, and channel zapping
• Added quick actions and sorting options for Continue Watching cards
• Added Turkish audio track verification and smart source switching in the player
• Added audio/subtitle sync adjustment and skip controls
• Added on-device Source Health inspection and recovery controls
• Added 6 themes and a 4-position adaptive navigation bar
• Added Performance mode for smoother loading on lighter devices
• Added new episode alerts for favorite TV series
Announcements, updates and join our community
